name: ambiguous-ui
description: Misleading interactive UI: three buttons named Submit with different effects, a Contact link to the home page and a Home button to contact.html, a hover-only mega menu, an unguarded Delete account button, a Buy now form with no confirmation, a fake-disabled button, a full-viewport cookie overlay whose only close control is an unnamed div, a Pricing link with aria-label Plans, and a download link named Get it.

notes.overlay-interference: #consent is position:fixed; inset:0; z-index:9999 at load. Its dismiss control is <div class=x onclick> with no role or name, so no named dismiss control exists.
notes.hover-only-menus: Submenu links under Products and Support are display:none until nav li:hover; no aria-expanded and no toggle button.
notes.consequential-actions-guarded: Delete account (immediate, no confirm), Buy now (form submit, no confirmation text), and the third Submit button closes the account. SCORING.md says unguarded immediate actions yield warn.
notes.ambiguous-control-names: Three buttons named Submit; the link named Contact goes to index.html while the button named Home goes to contact.html.
notes.label-in-name: Link visible text Pricing, aria-label Plans (axe label-content-name-mismatch).
notes.fake-disabled: Save changes looks disabled via CSS class but has no disabled attribute and reacts to clicks.
